class.name: VertexPerformanceManager
class.description: VertexPerformanceManager holds the active [VertexPerformanceProfile], pushes its values into engine and project settings, and monitors sustained frame-time degradation to scale rendering cost down (and back up) at runtime. It is registered as a singleton under the name [code]VertexPerformance[/code]. Enable monitoring to let it reduce the 3D render scale automatically when the engine sustains frame times above the profile threshold, and recover when performance is comfortable.

method.name: apply_to_project_settings
method.description: Writes the active profile into existing project settings (resolution, render scale, MSAA, max FPS, physics ticks, and Vertex quality budgets) so they take effect on the next launch and for subsystems that read them globally.

method.name: apply_live
method.description: Applies settings that can take effect immediately on the running scene tree (render scale, max FPS, physics tick rate).

method.name: create_profile
method.description: Creates a new profile initialized from one of the [enum VertexPerformanceProfile.Preset] values and returns it.

method.name: get_status
method.description: Returns a dictionary with the current monitoring state: [code]monitoring_enabled[/code], [code]current_render_scale[/code], [code]profile_render_scale[/code], [code]fps[/code], [code]slow_frame_streak[/code], [code]fast_frame_streak[/code].

method.name: reset_adaptive
method.description: Resets the adaptive streak counters and restores the render scale to the profile's baseline.

method.name: set_current_render_scale
method.description: Manually sets the live 3D render scale (clamped between 0.25 and 2.0).

method.name: tick
method.description: Performs one adaptive-quality evaluation. Called automatically by the internal monitor timer when monitoring is enabled; can also be called manually from scripting or tests.

members.member: If [code]true[/code], adaptive quality monitoring is active and the render scale may be adjusted automatically.
The active performance profile whose values are applied and monitored.

signal.name: adaptive_quality_changed
signal.description: Emitted when the adaptive system changes the live render scale.
